dia_chi_raw: Vulcan Labs, 11-13-15, Street No. 7, An Khanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Never settle, think bigger. Founded in 2017, Vulcan Labs is a technology company based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, specializing in the development of cutting-edge mobile applications that enhance productivity, education, and lifestyle. With over 30 published apps, several hundred thousand daily active users, and more than 25 million downloads, we are committed to building impactful digital products at scale. Our portfolio includes flagship products such as intelligent chatbots, math-solving tools, AI-driven interior design platforms, and resume builders—used by millions globally. At Vulcan Labs, we embrace a culture of integrity, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and growth mindset. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join our team and tackle meaningful challenges in an ever-evolving industry
 
RESPONSIBILITY:
We are looking for a Middle DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to join our technology team.
Design, build, automate, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure for development and production environments using GCP best practices.
Develop and operate CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and efficient software delivery.
Support developers in maintaining and troubleshooting development environments, with a focus on mobile app-related systems.
Collaborate with operations and development teams to deploy and manage software products.
Continuously enhance CI/CD workflows and adopt modern DevOps tools and methodologies.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance, availability, and security.
Manage domain configurations, DNS records, and SSL certificate provisioning.
Lead initiatives to optimize cloud infrastructure costs and improve resource efficiency.
yeu_cau:
2. REQUIREMENT:
Over 3 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Cloud Infrastructure roles.
Extensive hands-on expertise with Google Cloud Platform (GCP); familiarity with Azure and AWS is a strong advantage.
Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, including Terraform and Helm.
Skilled in building and maintaining cloud-native architectures integrating mobile apps with Firebase, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and Identity Platform.
Experienced with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
Proficient in using HashiCorp Vault, Kafka, and Redis for secure secret management and real-time data streaming.
Strong scripting abilities in Python, Bash, and Go.
Practical knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
Experienced with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Concourse CI, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions
Familiar with observability stacks including ELK and Coralogix for monitoring and alerting.
Understanding of mobile development ecosystems (iOS, Android) and backend integration.
Strong focus on cloud cost management and resource optimization.
Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, enabling close coordination with development teams and stakeholders.Nice to Have:
GCP certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, Cloud Architect).
Knowledge of security best practices in DevOps and cloud deployments.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
